claims_active_section_key.name: claims_active_section_key
claims_active_section_key.where: "claims"."released_at" is null and "claims"."section_id" is not null

page_comments_anchor_shape.name: page_comments_anchor_shape
page_comments_anchor_shape.value:
("page_comments"."block_fingerprint" is null and "page_comments"."block_index" is null and "page_comments"."quote" is null)
        or ("page_comments"."parent_id" is null and "page_comments"."block_fingerprint" is not null and "page_comments"."block_index" is not null and "page_comments"."block_index" >= 0 and "page_comments"."quote" is not null and "page_comments"."version" is not null)

page_comments_reply_shape.name: page_comments_reply_shape
page_comments_reply_shape.value: "page_comments"."parent_id" is null or ("page_comments"."resolved_at" is null and "page_comments"."version" is null)

page_reviews_note_length.name: page_reviews_note_length
page_reviews_note_length.value: "page_reviews"."note" is null or char_length("page_reviews"."note") between 1 and 2000

generated.as: setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce("title", '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce("summary", '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce("body", '')), 'C')
